en-US: Cloudflare Workers Builds now safely routes the default deploy command through EdgeEver's validated database migration and deployment pipeline, with a simpler quick-start flow.
Docker self-hosted images now build correctly with the guarded Cloudflare deployment tooling included.
Self-hosting guidance now highlights free-tier capacity more clearly and includes the Telegram community channel.
zh-CN: Cloudflare Workers Builds 现在会将默认部署命令安全接入 EdgeEver 已验证的数据库迁移与部署流水线，并简化快速上手流程。
Docker 自托管镜像现在可在包含 Cloudflare 部署保护工具的情况下正常构建。
自托管说明现在更清晰地展示免费额度，并补充 Telegram 社区频道入口。
